description: This Java class defines an Android activity that demonstrates the use of a NumberPicker widget, including setting its maximum value and toggling its enabled state via a CheckBox.

classes.name: NumberPickerActivity
classes.description: An Android activity class that demonstrates how to use a NumberPicker widget, including setting its maximum value and responding to a checkbox to enable or disable it.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, configures the NumberPicker's maximum value, and sets up a listener for the enabling checkbox.
